name: url
label: URL
help: Instagram profile URL, @handle, or username. Omit when userId is set. The URL platform must match this tool's platform.

name: userId
label: User ID
help: Instagram numeric user ID (e.g. 173560420). Faster than url — skips handle→ID resolve.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Max items to return. Default 20, max 200. Billed per result.

name: cursor
label: Cursor
help: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass nextCursor. Stop when hasMore is false.

name: cache
label: Cache
help: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache. Default false — always fetch fresh data.
